question: Does production memory retention reduce disk reads while copying, write admission, or query CPU queuing offsets latency gains?
measurement: Existing cold-sweep metrics and historical full-host CPU profiles, plus an interrupted warm-cache diagnostic
query_denominator: Report total, including failed and skipped queries
counter_boundaries: Prorate each bucket by overlap with the recorded per-workspace measurement window
distribution_mean: sum of distribution sums / sum of distribution counts
limitations: Different absolute query datasets and counts between versions
Split compaction counters combine ordinary trimming and same-range copying
Rollup and exporter timing obscure short bursts
CPU samples sometimes exceed host core count
Neither write rejections nor compaction counts prove a query latency mechanism

profiling_mcp.share_method: Convert totalMatchingValue and totalValue to the same unit, then divide. Inclusive filter populations overlap and must not be added.

disjoint_cpu_check.method: Convert symbolicated pprof with go tool pprof -raw, then assign each CPU-time sample to the first matching stack rule. Unknown leaves retain caller-based attribution when available.
disjoint_cpu_check.comparison_limit: One historical pod-minute, not the entire fleet window or a separate version comparison.

pod4_version_comparison.selection: Four profiles per version entirely inside the recorded workspace QPS10 measurement window. Boundary-overlapping profiles excluded.
pod4_version_comparison.weighting: Sum CPU seconds in each disjoint category and divide by total sampled CPU seconds for that version.
limitations: Interior profiles exclude the higher-pressure stage boundaries
Small metadata overlaps are reported, not de-duplicated without per-sample timestamps
Unknown innermost frames can be attributed only where caller symbols support it

diagnostic.cache_state: Retained warm state after the interrupted restart sweep
diagnostic.result: Traffic stopped after profiler initialization panicked on CreatingError. No profile or normal final request CSV. Not a completed performance comparison.

raw_data: Ignored under raw/; initial app-* metric-discovery files used app.datadoghq.com and are not used in this analysis
